unresolved_mappings.title: Generalized Tetanus

unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds a wound-management or toxin-mediated-disease objective.

unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: No action expected; appropriately out of core MCCQE scope.

unresolved_mappings.title: Lyme Disease

unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit if a future registry refresh adds a tick-borne-illness or arthropod-exposure objective.

unresolved_mappings.title: Syphilis
unresolved_mappings.issue: No MCC objective is titled for syphilis or STIs generally; nearest evidence (113, Vaginal discharge/vulvar pruritus) covers only the STI-differentiation angle from one presentation, not staged syphilis diagnosis/treatment broadly.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Revisit alongside chapter GY's SU-GY-17 (Sexually Transmitted Infections) during the global cross-chapter overlap audit; retain CORE_ACTION-adjacent depth given clinical importance regardless of registry gap.
